profile.name: Tosif Raza
profile.title: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer
profile.tagline: Practical web applications, from interface to API.
profile.shortBio: I build web applications with React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB. My projects explore inventory management, e-commerce, service marketplaces and content-managed portfolios.
profile.longBio:
I'm a full-stack JavaScript developer based in Kolkata, India. I work across React interfaces, Express APIs and MongoDB data models to build practical web applications.

My GitHub projects include StoreX for inventory and business operations, KING'S TEA for e-commerce, SkillBridge for customer and worker workflows, and TOSIF OS for portfolio content and personal productivity. KING'S TUTOR explores tutoring workflows as a frontend prototype.

I focus on clear user experiences and maintainable code, and continue learning through hands-on projects.

My practical training includes a MERN-stack internship at Web Guru Infosystem in Kolkata (September-November 2024) and a 60-hour Data Science with Python internship at AICT (June-July 2026). At AICT, I built a Fake News Detection training project using NLP and TF-IDF and earned O grade in the associated industrial training course.

I currently work as a Jr. Web Developer (Backend) at RIZ Software Consultancy in Kolkata, having joined on 16 September 2026.
profile.pitch: My work spans React interfaces, Node.js APIs and MongoDB data models. StoreX demonstrates business workflows and tenant-scoped data access; KING'S TEA includes storefront, checkout and content-management code; SkillBridge connects customer and worker workflows with Socket.IO messaging. The repositories show how I approach complete web applications, with project scope and limitations described alongside each build.

projects.title: StoreX
projects.tagline: Inventory, point of sale and business operations.
projects.description: A full-stack business management application with inventory, point-of-sale, sales, purchasing and customer workflows. React dashboards connect to an Express API with business-scoped MongoDB data and role-based access.
projects.problem: Bring product stock, sales, customer balances and purchasing into a shared business workspace.
projects.solution: The code separates React pages, API services and Mongoose models. Tenant middleware derives the business context from the authenticated user, while sales services coordinate sale items, inventory changes and customer records.
projects.caseStudy:
The React POS page loads products and customers through API services. The backend sale service checks stock, calculates line totals and uses a MongoDB session to write related records. Tenant middleware restricts business data access to the authenticated business context.

This is a source-code portfolio project. No customer, revenue or deployment figures are claimed.

projects.title: KING'S TEA
projects.tagline: A tea storefront with checkout and an admin CMS.
projects.description: A MERN e-commerce application with a customer storefront, product catalogue, cart, checkout and a separate admin portal. Backend code includes cash-on-delivery ordering, Razorpay integration and MongoDB-backed site content.
projects.problem: Connect a tea storefront with product, order and content management in one application.
projects.solution: Separate storefront and admin React apps share an Express API. The checkout controller calculates prices on the server and uses database transactions, while admin editors manage products, homepage content, media and order workflows.
projects.caseStudy:
The payment controller implements server-priced checkout, idempotency keys, cash-on-delivery orders and Razorpay verification paths. Published site-content endpoints serve stored homepage and policy content.

Online payments depend on configured Razorpay credentials and merchant settings. Recurring subscription enrolment is documented as disabled without a recurring-payment integration. No live sales or customer counts are claimed.

projects.title: SkillBridge
projects.tagline: A service marketplace with customer and worker portals.
projects.description: A full-stack service marketplace with customer, worker and admin interfaces. The React client uses Redux Toolkit, while the Express backend supports job applications, worker profiles, reviews and Socket.IO messaging.
projects.problem: Organise service requests, worker applications and conversations between customers and service providers.
projects.solution: Role-specific React routes share a Redux store for authentication, jobs, applications and chat. Backend services manage application status changes, and Socket.IO handlers deliver messages, typing indicators and read receipts.
projects.caseStudy:
The client and server are maintained in separate repositories. The application service handles proposals and application state changes; the socket handler connects conversation events with persisted chat messages.

[Frontend source](https://github.com/TosifRaza/skillbridge-client) · [Backend source](https://github.com/TosifRaza/skillbridge-server)

This describes the implementation in the repositories; no user adoption or marketplace revenue is asserted.

projects.title: TOSIF OS
projects.tagline: A portfolio, admin CMS and private productivity workspace.
projects.description: A database-driven portfolio paired with an admin control centre and a private personal workspace. The MERN application manages public content alongside goals, tasks, time entries, learning sessions and analytics.
projects.problem: Keep portfolio content editable while organising personal development work in the same application.
projects.solution: A public React site and an admin React app share an Express API. JWT-protected routes support the private workspace, while MongoDB stores project content, skills and activity records.
projects.caseStudy:
The repository contains separate Frontend, Admin-Portal and Backend applications. Public content has publish controls; the private workspace links goals, milestones and tasks and aggregates time and learning records. GitHub repository suggestions require admin review before becoming portfolio projects.

The public portfolio is linked from the GitHub profile at https://tosif.site/.

projects.title: KING'S TUTOR
projects.description: A React frontend prototype for student enrolment, tutor discovery and administrative lead workflows. It includes student, teacher and admin screens, with simulated service responses stored in the browser.
projects.problem: Explore the interfaces and navigation required to connect tutoring enquiries, teacher profiles and admin lead management.
projects.solution: Reusable UI components, React Router routes and service modules organise the prototype. The service layer provides a boundary where a real backend could replace the current mock handlers.
projects.caseStudy:
The repository explicitly defines this as frontend-only. Its apiClient dispatches to mock handlers, and localStorage persists demo interactions. OTP, SMS, email and payment flows are simulated; there is no connected production backend.

The project demonstrates interface design, component organisation, routing and service-layer structure.
